report.title: Lockfile bypass paths in the marketplace installer
report.question_or_target: Is there any command, flag or failure branch through which a dependency is installed at a version other than the lockfile pin - and does it warn?
report.answer: Yes. With 1.0.0 pinned, CLI update --frozen installs the 1.1.0 payload hash; with 1.1.0 pinned, CLI rollback --frozen installs the 1.0.0 hash. Both exit zero and emit no warning because the CLI accepts but does not forward --frozen. Explicit mutable install also changes the pin as designed. Direct API calls honor frozen, and no induced recovery branch fell back to an unpinned hash.
